description: Capture exactly one URL, bare DOI (10.1000/example) or arXiv id (2301.07041v2). Identifiers select a public HTTPS target, not verified authorship or quality. Versioned arXiv requests preserve that version; unversioned ids mean latest at capture. A DOI may return only an HTML landing page, not full paper text. The same URL/redirect/PDF limits apply; no OCR or paywall bypass. Reuse operation_key with the same locator after a lost receipt, then read the saved source/provenance before citing.
validation: The server validates exactly one non-null locator; the signature schema alone does not enforce mutual exclusion.
